max_drawdown_halt_limit.description: Permanent capital-floor entry halt (0.20 = 20%). Closed, realized equity is compared with cumulative gross deposits (execution_state.cumulative_deposits), not a rolling peak or the signed net-funding balance; withdrawals do not reduce this reference. Legacy requests without cumulative_deposits use execution_config.initial_balance. The shared live/paper evaluator checks before each bar and latches execution_state.halt. New alpha entries and v3 core allocations are denied, while authoritative positions retain protective exits and exits_pending until physically flat. Engine-owned strategies become inactive only after that book is flat; caller-owned executors retain their exit monitor. An explicit manual restart is required to clear the latch. Backtests enforce the same floor when evaluate_bar receives enforce_capital_floor=True, managing open-position exits through the final bar. Applies to both cooldown models; null disables new floor trips, while an existing halt remains latched.

min_balance_threshold.description: Cash reserve fraction held back from new entries (0.1 = 10%). v1 reserves this fraction of cash; v2 reserves this fraction of account value (cash + open positions at market). An entry may only use cash above the reserve; when no cash is deployable the entry is denied (insufficient_cash / insufficient_cash_v2_account_reserve). It never halts the strategy and never closes positions.
min_balance_threshold.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more cash idle and makes entries smaller or rarer as the account shrinks; lower lets entries use more of the balance. Not a drawdown stop; see max_drawdown_limit and max_drawdown_halt_limit.
min_balance_threshold.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_cash_balance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Minimum cash balance the strategy holds after the worst-case loss of every open trade.
min_cash_balance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more cash out of reach of buy trades and core buys, so entries are smaller or rarer; lower frees more cash for trading.

min_stop_distance_pct.description: Hard floor on stop distance as a fraction of entry price (crypto minimum), applied after ATR sizing.
min_stop_distance_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Higher enforces a wider minimum stop; lower allows tighter stops down to the floor.
min_stop_distance_pct.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_trade_amount.description: Minimum trade size in dollars; smaller intended trades are skipped.
min_trade_amount.x-mangrove-effect: Higher skips more small signals; lower allows smaller trades.
min_trade_amount.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

position_size_calc.description: Sizing-engine version ('v1', 'v2' or 'v3'). Pinned at creation and immutable. 'v3' holds an asset balance and a cash balance, sizes against equity net of open risk, and requires the position_size_calc 'v3' parameters.
position_size_calc.x-mangrove-effect: Not a magnitude knob; selects the sizing algorithm. Do not change on an existing strategy.

profit_threshold_pct.description: Profit threshold (5%% default) above which a position counts as 'winning' for the time-based exit logic.
profit_threshold_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Higher requires a larger gain before a position is treated as winning; lower treats smaller gains as wins.
profit_threshold_pct.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

rebalance_band.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Absolute deviation of the asset weight from target_asset_weight that triggers a rebalance order (0.05 = 5 points).
rebalance_band.x-mangrove-effect: Higher lets the split drift further before a rebalance order, so fewer core orders; lower holds the split closer to target with more core orders and more fees.

reward_factor.description: Risk/reward target. Take-profit distance = reward_factor * stop_distance.
reward_factor.x-mangrove-effect: Higher sets a wider profit target: lower win rate but bigger wins. Lower sets a tighter target: higher win rate but smaller wins.
reward_factor.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

stop_gap_allowance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Fraction of the stop price a stop fill is assumed to miss by when computing the worst-case loss of a trade (0.01 = 1%).
stop_gap_allowance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher counts more risk per open trade, leaving less available cash and smaller positions; lower counts less.

stop_model.description: Which stop model the strategy uses: 'atr_width_dial' (one parameter, volatility_tolerance, positioned on the ATR width) or 'weighted_atr' (superseded: a weighted blend of two ATRs, capped). Pinned at creation and immutable.
stop_model.x-mangrove-effect: Not a magnitude knob; selects the stop algorithm. Do not change on an existing strategy -- it would move every stop the strategy takes.

taker_fee_rate.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Venue fee per fill as a fraction of notional, charged in cash (0.004 = 0.4%).
taker_fee_rate.x-mangrove-effect: Higher counts more cost per fill, raising the risk of each trade and lowering available cash. Models the venue; not a strategy-character knob.

target_asset_weight.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Target share of core value held in the asset (0.8 = 80% asset, 20% cash; 0 = all cash).
target_asset_weight.x-mangrove-effect: Higher holds more of the asset and less cash; lower holds more cash. The daily core order moves the split back to this value once it drifts past rebalance_band. At 0 with no asset held, no core order is placed and only buy trades can pass.

target_volatility.description: Target volatility (0.10 = 10%). ONLY active when enable_volatility_adjustment is true (default false). When active, scales position size down if ATR%% of entry exceeds the target (never up).
target_volatility.x-mangrove-effect: With the gate off (the default), changing this has no effect. With it on, lower scales positions down more aggressively in high volatility.
target_volatility.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

volatility_mode.description: Unused (retained for backward compatibility). Volatility is derived from ATR.
volatility_mode.x-mangrove-effect: No runtime effect. Do not tune.

volatility_tolerance.description: Where on the ATR width the stop is taken, as the ATR_long-vs-ATR_short contribution ratio: 0 is all short end (0.5x the signal timeframe's ATR), 1 is all long end (2x the daily ATR). Interpolated geometrically, so the value is exactly the long end's share of log(stop) and each 0.1 is the same multiplicative step. Replaces atr_short_weight, atr_long_weight and atr_cap_multiplier.
volatility_tolerance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher widens the stop, and because position size is the risk budget divided by the stop distance, exposure shrinks in exact inverse proportion at the SAME risk. Low means many units with little room to be wrong and frequent stop-outs; high means few units that are hard to shake out but need a much larger move to reach the same reward. Both risk max_risk_per_trade.
volatility_tolerance.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

volatility_window.description: Unused (retained for backward compatibility). ATR windowing is controlled by atr_period.
volatility_window.x-mangrove-effect: No runtime effect. Do not tune.
volatility_window.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

Canon defaults are 36 primary bars for a loss pause, 72 for a drawdown pause, and three strikes for a permanent halt. Pause counts are clamped to 24 hours through 14 days by default. max_drawdown_halt_limit separately stops entries on realized loss of cumulative gross deposits. Existing exits remain active during holds.

loss_amount_pct.description: Accumulated net losses as a fraction of the closed-equity reset baseline that start a loss pause. A winning close clears the accumulation and resets the baseline. An asset loss pause clears it at the start and re-baselines at expiry; a global drawdown pause does not itself reset it.
loss_amount_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Lower pauses after smaller cumulative losses; higher tolerates larger ones.

max_consecutive_pauses.description: Strikes that stop the strategy until a manual restart. A strike is one pause started, of any kind (consecutive losses, loss amount, drawdown, a resume window that lost money). Strikes reset to 0 only on a new equity high: a close that leaves closed equity above the high-water mark the strategy had when the first strike of the run was recorded. A winning close below that mark does not reset them, and a deposit or withdrawal does not count as a high.
max_consecutive_pauses.x-mangrove-effect: Lower stops the strategy sooner; higher tolerates more repeated pauses.

pause_bars.description: Primary-timeframe bars denying entries after a loss pause (canon default 36). The count is raised to cover pause_min_hours and lowered to fit pause_max_days on that timeframe (24 hours through 14 days by default).
pause_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Longer sits out more of a bad regime; shorter resumes sooner.

pause_max_days.description: A pause lasts at most this many days on every timeframe: the bar count is lowered to fit it.
pause_max_days.x-mangrove-effect: Lower ends every pause sooner on long timeframes; higher leaves the bar count to decide.

pause_min_hours.description: A pause lasts at least this many hours on every timeframe: the bar count of pause_bars or drawdown_pause_bars is raised to cover it.
pause_min_hours.x-mangrove-effect: Higher makes every pause at least that long on short timeframes; lower leaves the bar count to decide.

resume_size_fraction.description: Fraction of normal size for new alpha positions while a resume window is open (canon default 0.5). Eligible confirmed position closes count toward resume_trades; a negative net result starts another loss pause and strike, while zero or a profit restores full alpha size. Core orders keep their normal allocation quantities after pause expiry: they are not positions and do not consume resume-trade counts. 1.0 disables the alpha size reduction.
resume_size_fraction.x-mangrove-effect: Lower risks less while the strategy proves itself again after a pause; higher resumes closer to full size.

resume_trades.description: Eligible confirmed position closes booked in a resume window (canon default three). When the window completes, a negative net realized result starts a new loss pause and strike; zero or a profit restores full alpha size. A pause cancels the active window; a new one opens only once no pause remains and no permanent halt is latched. Core orders do not count as position closes.
resume_trades.x-mangrove-effect: Higher judges the resumed strategy over more trades before full size returns; lower decides sooner.

x-mangrove-authoring-schema.x-mangrove-effect: Tighter limits pause and stop sooner; looser limits keep trading through losing runs.

An absent model adopts the canonical 'trades' defaults; explicit 'bars' retains the legacy model.

max_consecutive_pauses.description: Strikes that stop the strategy until a manual restart. A strike is one pause started, of any kind (consecutive losses, loss amount, drawdown, a resume window that lost money). Strikes reset to 0 only on a new equity high: a close that leaves closed equity above the high-water mark the strategy had when the first strike of the run was recorded. A winning close below that mark does not reset them, and a deposit or withdrawal does not count as a high.
max_consecutive_pauses.x-mangrove-effect: Lower stops the strategy sooner; higher tolerates more repeated pauses.

pause_bars.description: Primary-timeframe bars denying entries after a loss pause (canon default 36). The count is raised to cover pause_min_hours and lowered to fit pause_max_days on that timeframe (24 hours through 14 days by default).
pause_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Longer sits out more of a bad regime; shorter resumes sooner.

pause_max_days.description: A pause lasts at most this many days on every timeframe: the bar count is lowered to fit it.
pause_max_days.x-mangrove-effect: Lower ends every pause sooner on long timeframes; higher leaves the bar count to decide.

pause_min_hours.description: A pause lasts at least this many hours on every timeframe: the bar count of pause_bars or drawdown_pause_bars is raised to cover it.
pause_min_hours.x-mangrove-effect: Higher makes every pause at least that long on short timeframes; lower leaves the bar count to decide.

resume_size_fraction.description: Fraction of normal size for new alpha positions while a resume window is open (canon default 0.5). Eligible confirmed position closes count toward resume_trades; a negative net result starts another loss pause and strike, while zero or a profit restores full alpha size. Core orders keep their normal allocation quantities after pause expiry: they are not positions and do not consume resume-trade counts. 1.0 disables the alpha size reduction.
resume_size_fraction.x-mangrove-effect: Lower risks less while the strategy proves itself again after a pause; higher resumes closer to full size.

resume_trades.description: Eligible confirmed position closes booked in a resume window (canon default three). When the window completes, a negative net realized result starts a new loss pause and strike; zero or a profit restores full alpha size. A pause cancels the active window; a new one opens only once no pause remains and no permanent halt is latched. Core orders do not count as position closes.
resume_trades.x-mangrove-effect: Higher judges the resumed strategy over more trades before full size returns; lower decides sooner.

circuit_breaker.x-mangrove-effect: Tighter limits pause and stop sooner; looser limits keep trading through losing runs.

cooldown_model.description: Loss-streak breaker model. 'bars' counts losing closes inside rolling windows of the primary timeframe (cooldown_config). 'trades' counts consecutive losing closes and realized loss amount, pauses for circuit_breaker bars of the primary timeframe (at least pause_min_hours and at most pause_max_days), and stops after repeated pauses (circuit_breaker). An absent model adopts the canonical 'trades' defaults; explicit 'bars' retains the legacy model.
cooldown_model.x-mangrove-effect: 'trades' trips on trade count and loss size regardless of how far apart trades are spaced; 'bars' trips only when losses land inside the window. cooldown_config, cooldown_bars, daily_momentum_limit and weekly_momentum_limit are read only under 'bars': they are left out of a resolved config under 'trades', and a config that carries them under 'trades' has them dropped.

enable_volatility_adjustment.x-mangrove-effect: When true, positions are scaled down by target_volatility / (atr/entry) if ATR%% exceeds target; only reduces size, never increases.

exit_on_loss_after_bars.description: Exit a losing position after this many bars.
exit_on_loss_after_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Lower cuts losers sooner; higher gives them more time to recover.
exit_on_loss_after_bars.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

exit_on_profit_after_bars.description: Exit a winning position after this many bars.
exit_on_profit_after_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Lower banks winners sooner; higher lets them run.
exit_on_profit_after_bars.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

initial_balance.x-mangrove-effect: Scales absolute dollar figures; not a strategy-character knob.
initial_balance.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_drawdown_halt_limit.description: Permanent capital-floor entry halt (0.20 = 20%). Closed, realized equity is compared with cumulative gross deposits (execution_state.cumulative_deposits), not a rolling peak or the signed net-funding balance; withdrawals do not reduce this reference. Legacy requests without cumulative_deposits use execution_config.initial_balance. The shared live/paper evaluator checks before each bar and latches execution_state.halt. New alpha entries and v3 core allocations are denied, while authoritative positions retain protective exits and exits_pending until physically flat. Engine-owned strategies become inactive only after that book is flat; caller-owned executors retain their exit monitor. An explicit manual restart is required to clear the latch. Backtests enforce the same floor when evaluate_bar receives enforce_capital_floor=True, managing open-position exits through the final bar. Applies to both cooldown models; null disables new floor trips, while an existing halt remains latched.
max_drawdown_halt_limit.x-mangrove-effect: Lower protects more of gross deposited capital before a permanent entry halt; higher tolerates a deeper realized loss. This does not resize positions or stop protective exit evaluation. Do not add a separate floor where the shared evaluator enforces it.
max_drawdown_halt_limit.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_drawdown_limit.description: Peak-relative entry pause (0.20 = 20%). The canonical 'trades' model measures marked equity against its high-water mark. A breach starts one drawdown pause and strike; circuit_breaker.drawdown_pause_bars defaults to 72 primary bars, clamped to pause_min_hours and pause_max_days (24 hours and 14 days by default). At drawdown-pause expiry the peak re-baselines; a reduced-size alpha resume window opens only once no pause remains and no permanent halt is latched. Explicit 'bars' retains the legacy closed-equity measurement and per-timeframe long cooldown. Both models deny new entries while allowing existing positions to exit; automatic v3 core allocations honor the hold too. null disables new drawdown trips.
max_drawdown_limit.x-mangrove-effect: Lower pauses entries after a smaller drawdown; higher tolerates a deeper drawdown. The shared entry breaker enforces this in single/bulk live and paper evaluation, v3 core allocation and backtests built with risk_manager_from_execution_config. Alpha resume sizing is a separate control; do not add a second drawdown stop.
max_drawdown_limit.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_hold_bars.description: Maximum bars to hold any position before a forced exit.
max_hold_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Higher lets trades run longer; lower forces earlier time-based exits.
max_hold_bars.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_hold_time_hours.description: Maximum position hold time in hours (null = no limit).
max_hold_time_hours.x-mangrove-effect: Lower forces earlier time-based exits; null/higher lets trades run indefinitely on time.
max_hold_time_hours.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_open_positions.x-mangrove-effect: Higher allows more simultaneous exposure (more diversification but more aggregate risk); lower is more selective with less aggregate exposure.
max_open_positions.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_risk_per_trade.description: Fraction of account equity risked per trade (0.01 = 1%). Position size is derived from this and the stop distance.
max_risk_per_trade.x-mangrove-effect: Higher risks more per trade: bigger positions, larger gains AND larger drawdowns. Lower is more conservative: smaller positions, smaller swings.
max_risk_per_trade.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_trade_amount.description: Absolute cap on dollar size per trade.
max_trade_amount.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_trades_per_day.x-mangrove-effect: Higher permits more churn; lower throttles activity.
max_trades_per_day.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_units_per_trade.description: Absolute cap on units per trade.
max_units_per_trade.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_asset_balance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Minimum asset balance, in asset units, the strategy holds outside open trades.
min_asset_balance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more of the asset out of reach of sell trades and core sells, and takes more cash to reach; lower frees more of the asset for trading.

min_balance_days.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Number of equal daily orders used to bring a side up to its minimum balance.
min_balance_days.x-mangrove-effect: Higher spreads the minimum-balance orders over more days at smaller size; lower reaches the minimum sooner with larger orders.

min_balance_threshold.description: Cash reserve fraction held back from new entries (0.1 = 10%). v1 reserves this fraction of cash; v2 reserves this fraction of account value (cash + open positions at market). An entry may only use cash above the reserve; when no cash is deployable the entry is denied (insufficient_cash / insufficient_cash_v2_account_reserve). It never halts the strategy and never closes positions.
min_balance_threshold.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more cash idle and makes entries smaller or rarer as the account shrinks; lower lets entries use more of the balance. Not a drawdown stop; see max_drawdown_limit and max_drawdown_halt_limit.
min_balance_threshold.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_cash_balance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Minimum cash balance the strategy holds after the worst-case loss of every open trade.
min_cash_balance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more cash out of reach of buy trades and core buys, so entries are smaller or rarer; lower frees more cash for trading.

min_stop_distance_pct.description: Hard floor on stop distance as a fraction of entry price (crypto minimum), applied after ATR sizing.
min_stop_distance_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Higher enforces a wider minimum stop; lower allows tighter stops down to the floor.
min_stop_distance_pct.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_trade_amount.description: Minimum trade size in dollars; smaller intended trades are skipped.
min_trade_amount.x-mangrove-effect: Higher skips more small signals; lower allows smaller trades.
min_trade_amount.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

position_size_calc.description: Sizing-engine version ('v1', 'v2' or 'v3'). Pinned at creation and immutable. 'v3' holds an asset balance and a cash balance, sizes against equity net of open risk, and requires the position_size_calc 'v3' parameters.
position_size_calc.x-mangrove-effect: Not a magnitude knob; selects the sizing algorithm. Do not change on an existing strategy.

profit_threshold_pct.description: Profit threshold (5%% default) above which a position counts as 'winning' for the time-based exit logic.
profit_threshold_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Higher requires a larger gain before a position is treated as winning; lower treats smaller gains as wins.
profit_threshold_pct.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

rebalance_band.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Absolute deviation of the asset weight from target_asset_weight that triggers a rebalance order (0.05 = 5 points).
rebalance_band.x-mangrove-effect: Higher lets the split drift further before a rebalance order, so fewer core orders; lower holds the split closer to target with more core orders and more fees.

reward_factor.description: Risk/reward target. Take-profit distance = reward_factor * stop_distance.
reward_factor.x-mangrove-effect: Higher sets a wider profit target: lower win rate but bigger wins. Lower sets a tighter target: higher win rate but smaller wins.
reward_factor.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

stop_gap_allowance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Fraction of the stop price a stop fill is assumed to miss by when computing the worst-case loss of a trade (0.01 = 1%).
stop_gap_allowance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher counts more risk per open trade, leaving less available cash and smaller positions; lower counts less.

stop_model.description: Which stop model the strategy uses: 'atr_width_dial' (one parameter, volatility_tolerance, positioned on the ATR width) or 'weighted_atr' (superseded: a weighted blend of two ATRs, capped). Pinned at creation and immutable.
stop_model.x-mangrove-effect: Not a magnitude knob; selects the stop algorithm. Do not change on an existing strategy -- it would move every stop the strategy takes.

taker_fee_rate.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Venue fee per fill as a fraction of notional, charged in cash (0.004 = 0.4%).
taker_fee_rate.x-mangrove-effect: Higher counts more cost per fill, raising the risk of each trade and lowering available cash. Models the venue; not a strategy-character knob.

target_asset_weight.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Target share of core value held in the asset (0.8 = 80% asset, 20% cash; 0 = all cash).
target_asset_weight.x-mangrove-effect: Higher holds more of the asset and less cash; lower holds more cash. The daily core order moves the split back to this value once it drifts past rebalance_band. At 0 with no asset held, no core order is placed and only buy trades can pass.

target_volatility.description: Target volatility (0.10 = 10%). ONLY active when enable_volatility_adjustment is true (default false). When active, scales position size down if ATR%% of entry exceeds the target (never up).
target_volatility.x-mangrove-effect: With the gate off (the default), changing this has no effect. With it on, lower scales positions down more aggressively in high volatility.
target_volatility.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

volatility_mode.description: Unused (retained for backward compatibility). Volatility is derived from ATR.
volatility_mode.x-mangrove-effect: No runtime effect. Do not tune.

volatility_tolerance.description: Where on the ATR width the stop is taken, as the ATR_long-vs-ATR_short contribution ratio: 0 is all short end (0.5x the signal timeframe's ATR), 1 is all long end (2x the daily ATR). Interpolated geometrically, so the value is exactly the long end's share of log(stop) and each 0.1 is the same multiplicative step. Replaces atr_short_weight, atr_long_weight and atr_cap_multiplier.
volatility_tolerance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher widens the stop, and because position size is the risk budget divided by the stop distance, exposure shrinks in exact inverse proportion at the SAME risk. Low means many units with little room to be wrong and frequent stop-outs; high means few units that are hard to shake out but need a much larger move to reach the same reward. Both risk max_risk_per_trade.
volatility_tolerance.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

volatility_window.description: Unused (retained for backward compatibility). ATR windowing is controlled by atr_period.
volatility_window.x-mangrove-effect: No runtime effect. Do not tune.
volatility_window.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

post.description:
This endpoint runs a single-strategy backtest using `strategy_json`.

This synchronous surface has a ~15s transport budget. Prefer the
async surface (`POST /api/v2/backtests/`, then poll status) for long
lookbacks -- it has no such ceiling.

The backtest engine runs one backtest at a time. If another synchronous
backtest is already running (`ENGINE_BUSY`), or a cold long-window
request cannot finish inside the transport budget (`ENGINE_WARMING`),
this returns `503` with a `Retry-After` header rather than blocking
until the gateway times out -- retry after the indicated delay, or use
the async endpoint for long lookbacks and the bulk endpoint for
many-strategy workloads.

Stop parameters (atr_period, volatility_tolerance) are read from `execution_config`.
If not provided, defaults from trading_defaults.json are used. These values are
injected into the Strategy object at runtime and should NOT be included in strategy_json.

Market data can be sourced from:
- Market Data API: set `data_source="api"` (default) and provide `asset`, `interval`, `lookback_months`
- Local CSV file: set `data_source="file"` and provide `data_file`

Legacy support:
- `hourly_data_file` is accepted and treated as `data_file` (file mode)

Returns:
- success: Boolean indicating if backtest completed successfully
- metrics: Dict with performance metrics
- trade_history: List of serialized TradeRecord objects (entry/exit prices, timestamps, profit/loss, exit reasons)
- error: Error message if backtest failed
- execution_time_seconds: Time taken to run backtest
- trade_count: Number of trades executed
- strategy_names: List of strategy names that were run

post.description:
Market data is fetched once per unique (asset, timeframe) pair and
shared across all strategies that need the same data.  For example,
four BTC/1h strategies result in a single API call for BTC 1h data.

Strategy sources
----------------
Provide exactly one of:
- **strategy_ids** -- list of UUIDs from the strategies table. Strategies
  are loaded from the database and must belong to the caller's org.
- **strategy_configs** -- list of strategy config objects in the canonical
  entry/exit format (same structure as the ``strategy_json`` field in
  ``POST /backtest``, but already parsed as JSON objects, not strings).

Date range
----------
Both ``start_date`` and ``end_date`` are required.

Execution config
----------------
``execution_config`` is optional and is applied to every strategy in the
batch.  Per-strategy execution_config embedded inside each strategy record
is merged on top of this value.  If omitted entirely, defaults from
``trading_defaults.json`` are used (atr_period=14, volatility_tolerance=0.5).

Failures
--------
Individual strategy failures are captured per-result and do not abort
the batch.  Check ``results[i].success`` and ``results[i].error`` for
each strategy.

Subscription counting
---------------------
Each strategy result that produced at least one round trip
(``trade_count >= 2``) increments the backtest usage counter once; a
result below that threshold is a dry run or a config error and is NOT
charged, as are technical failures (engine-busy, oracle error).  See
``docs/architecture/billable-endpoints.md`` for rationale and
``services.counts_against_quota`` for the rule itself.  Accounting lives

This synchronous surface has a ~15s transport budget. Prefer the
async surface (`POST /api/v2/backtests/`, then poll status) for long

backtest is already running (`ENGINE_BUSY`), or a cold long-window
request cannot finish inside the transport budget (`ENGINE_WARMING`),
this returns `503` with a `Retry-After` header rather than blocking

the async endpoint for long lookbacks and the bulk endpoint for

- error: Error message if backtest failed
- execution_time_seconds: Time taken to run backtest

Market data is fetched once per unique (asset, timeframe) pair and
shared across all strategies that need the same data.  For example,
four BTC/1h strategies result in a single API call for BTC 1h data.

Strategy sources
----------------
Provide exactly one of:
- **strategy_ids** -- list of UUIDs from the strategies table. Strategies
  are loaded from the database and must belong to the caller's org.
- **strategy_configs** -- list of strategy config objects in the canonical

  ``POST /backtest``, but already parsed as JSON objects, not strings).

Date range
----------
Both ``start_date`` and ``end_date`` are required.

Execution config
----------------
``execution_config`` is optional and is applied to every strategy in the
batch.  Per-strategy execution_config embedded inside each strategy record
is merged on top of this value.  If omitted entirely, defaults from
``trading_defaults.json`` are used (atr_period=14, volatility_tolerance=0.5).

Failures
--------
Individual strategy failures are captured per-result and do not abort
the batch.  Check ``results[i].success`` and ``results[i].error`` for
each strategy.

(``trade_count >= 2``) increments the backtest usage counter once; a
result below that threshold is a dry run or a config error and is NOT
charged, as are technical failures (engine-busy, oracle error).  See
``docs/architecture/billable-endpoints.md`` for rationale and
``services.counts_against_quota`` for the rule itself.  Accounting lives
in ``services.run_bulk_backtest``, not in this route.  The total
required quota is checked upfront.  The response includes
``X-Quota-Counted-Total`` and ``X-Quota-Counted-Of`` headers so callers
can tell how many results actually counted.

circuit_breaker.description: Parameters for cooldown_model 'trades': pause on consecutive net losses or accumulated loss amount, pause on marked drawdown from the peak (including unrealized changes), resume new alpha positions at a reduced size, and stop after consecutive pauses. Canon defaults are 36 primary bars for a loss pause, 72 for a drawdown pause, and three strikes for a permanent halt. Pause counts are clamped to 24 hours through 14 days by default. max_drawdown_halt_limit separately stops entries on realized loss of cumulative gross deposits. Existing exits remain active during holds.

x-mangrove-authoring-schema.description: Parameters for cooldown_model 'trades': pause on consecutive net losses or accumulated loss amount, pause on marked drawdown from the peak (including unrealized changes), resume new alpha positions at a reduced size, and stop after consecutive pauses. Canon defaults are 36 primary bars for a loss pause, 72 for a drawdown pause, and three strikes for a permanent halt. Pause counts are clamped to 24 hours through 14 days by default. max_drawdown_halt_limit separately stops entries on realized loss of cumulative gross deposits. Existing exits remain active during holds.

consecutive_loss_limit.description: Consecutive losing closes on an asset that start a pause. A winning close resets the count.
consecutive_loss_limit.x-mangrove-effect: Lower pauses sooner after a losing run; higher tolerates longer runs.

drawdown_pause_bars.description: Primary-timeframe bars denying entries after a drawdown pause (canon default 72). At drawdown-pause expiry the peak re-baselines to current account value. An alpha resume window opens only once no pause remains and no permanent halt is latched. The count is raised to cover pause_min_hours and lowered to fit pause_max_days (24 hours through 14 days by default).
drawdown_pause_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Longer holds the pause longer before trading can resume.

loss_amount_pct.description: Accumulated net losses as a fraction of the closed-equity reset baseline that start a loss pause. A winning close clears the accumulation and resets the baseline. An asset loss pause clears it at the start and re-baselines at expiry; a global drawdown pause does not itself reset it.
loss_amount_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Lower pauses after smaller cumulative losses; higher tolerates larger ones.

max_consecutive_pauses.description: Strikes that stop the strategy until a manual restart. A strike is one pause started, of any kind (consecutive losses, loss amount, drawdown, a resume window that lost money). Strikes reset to 0 only on a new equity high: a close that leaves closed equity above the high-water mark the strategy had when the first strike of the run was recorded. A winning close below that mark does not reset them, and a deposit or withdrawal does not count as a high.
max_consecutive_pauses.x-mangrove-effect: Lower stops the strategy sooner; higher tolerates more repeated pauses.

pause_bars.description: Primary-timeframe bars denying entries after a loss pause (canon default 36). The count is raised to cover pause_min_hours and lowered to fit pause_max_days on that timeframe (24 hours through 14 days by default).
pause_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Longer sits out more of a bad regime; shorter resumes sooner.

pause_max_days.description: A pause lasts at most this many days on every timeframe: the bar count is lowered to fit it.
pause_max_days.x-mangrove-effect: Lower ends every pause sooner on long timeframes; higher leaves the bar count to decide.

pause_min_hours.description: A pause lasts at least this many hours on every timeframe: the bar count of pause_bars or drawdown_pause_bars is raised to cover it.
pause_min_hours.x-mangrove-effect: Higher makes every pause at least that long on short timeframes; lower leaves the bar count to decide.

resume_size_fraction.description: Fraction of normal size for new alpha positions while a resume window is open (canon default 0.5). Eligible confirmed position closes count toward resume_trades; a negative net result starts another loss pause and strike, while zero or a profit restores full alpha size. Core orders keep their normal allocation quantities after pause expiry: they are not positions and do not consume resume-trade counts. 1.0 disables the alpha size reduction.
resume_size_fraction.x-mangrove-effect: Lower risks less while the strategy proves itself again after a pause; higher resumes closer to full size.

resume_trades.description: Eligible confirmed position closes booked in a resume window (canon default three). When the window completes, a negative net realized result starts a new loss pause and strike; zero or a profit restores full alpha size. A pause cancels the active window; a new one opens only once no pause remains and no permanent halt is latched. Core orders do not count as position closes.
resume_trades.x-mangrove-effect: Higher judges the resumed strategy over more trades before full size returns; lower decides sooner.

x-mangrove-authoring-schema.x-mangrove-effect: Tighter limits pause and stop sooner; looser limits keep trading through losing runs.

cooldown_model.description: Loss-streak breaker model. 'bars' counts losing closes inside rolling windows of the primary timeframe (cooldown_config). 'trades' counts consecutive losing closes and realized loss amount, pauses for circuit_breaker bars of the primary timeframe (at least pause_min_hours and at most pause_max_days), and stops after repeated pauses (circuit_breaker). An absent model adopts the canonical 'trades' defaults; explicit 'bars' retains the legacy model.

max_drawdown_halt_limit.description: Permanent capital-floor entry halt (0.20 = 20%). Closed, realized equity is compared with cumulative gross deposits (execution_state.cumulative_deposits), not a rolling peak or the signed net-funding balance; withdrawals do not reduce this reference. Legacy requests without cumulative_deposits use execution_config.initial_balance. The shared live/paper evaluator checks before each bar and latches execution_state.halt. New alpha entries and v3 core allocations are denied, while authoritative positions retain protective exits and exits_pending until physically flat. Engine-owned strategies become inactive only after that book is flat; caller-owned executors retain their exit monitor. An explicit manual restart is required to clear the latch. Backtests enforce the same floor when evaluate_bar receives enforce_capital_floor=True, managing open-position exits through the final bar. Applies to both cooldown models; null disables new floor trips, while an existing halt remains latched.

max_open_positions.x-mangrove-effect: Higher allows more simultaneous exposure (more diversification but more aggregate risk); lower is more selective with less aggregate exposure.
max_open_positions.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_risk_per_trade.description: Fraction of account equity risked per trade (0.01 = 1%). Position size is derived from this and the stop distance.
max_risk_per_trade.x-mangrove-effect: Higher risks more per trade: bigger positions, larger gains AND larger drawdowns. Lower is more conservative: smaller positions, smaller swings.
max_risk_per_trade.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_trade_amount.description: Absolute cap on dollar size per trade.
max_trade_amount.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_trades_per_day.x-mangrove-effect: Higher permits more churn; lower throttles activity.
max_trades_per_day.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_units_per_trade.description: Absolute cap on units per trade.

min_asset_balance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Minimum asset balance, in asset units, the strategy holds outside open trades.
min_asset_balance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more of the asset out of reach of sell trades and core sells, and takes more cash to reach; lower frees more of the asset for trading.

min_balance_days.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Number of equal daily orders used to bring a side up to its minimum balance.
min_balance_days.x-mangrove-effect: Higher spreads the minimum-balance orders over more days at smaller size; lower reaches the minimum sooner with larger orders.

min_balance_threshold.description: Cash reserve fraction held back from new entries (0.1 = 10%). v1 reserves this fraction of cash; v2 reserves this fraction of account value (cash + open positions at market). An entry may only use cash above the reserve; when no cash is deployable the entry is denied (insufficient_cash / insufficient_cash_v2_account_reserve). It never halts the strategy and never closes positions.
min_balance_threshold.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more cash idle and makes entries smaller or rarer as the account shrinks; lower lets entries use more of the balance. Not a drawdown stop; see max_drawdown_limit and max_drawdown_halt_limit.
min_balance_threshold.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_cash_balance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Minimum cash balance the strategy holds after the worst-case loss of every open trade.
min_cash_balance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more cash out of reach of buy trades and core buys, so entries are smaller or rarer; lower frees more cash for trading.

min_stop_distance_pct.description: Hard floor on stop distance as a fraction of entry price (crypto minimum), applied after ATR sizing.
min_stop_distance_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Higher enforces a wider minimum stop; lower allows tighter stops down to the floor.
min_stop_distance_pct.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_trade_amount.description: Minimum trade size in dollars; smaller intended trades are skipped.
min_trade_amount.x-mangrove-effect: Higher skips more small signals; lower allows smaller trades.
min_trade_amount.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

position_size_calc.description: Sizing-engine version ('v1', 'v2' or 'v3'). Pinned at creation and immutable. 'v3' holds an asset balance and a cash balance, sizes against equity net of open risk, and requires the position_size_calc 'v3' parameters.
position_size_calc.x-mangrove-effect: Not a magnitude knob; selects the sizing algorithm. Do not change on an existing strategy.

profit_threshold_pct.description: Profit threshold (5%% default) above which a position counts as 'winning' for the time-based exit logic.
profit_threshold_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Higher requires a larger gain before a position is treated as winning; lower treats smaller gains as wins.
profit_threshold_pct.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

rebalance_band.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Absolute deviation of the asset weight from target_asset_weight that triggers a rebalance order (0.05 = 5 points).
rebalance_band.x-mangrove-effect: Higher lets the split drift further before a rebalance order, so fewer core orders; lower holds the split closer to target with more core orders and more fees.

reward_factor.description: Risk/reward target. Take-profit distance = reward_factor * stop_distance.
reward_factor.x-mangrove-effect: Higher sets a wider profit target: lower win rate but bigger wins. Lower sets a tighter target: higher win rate but smaller wins.
reward_factor.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

stop_gap_allowance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Fraction of the stop price a stop fill is assumed to miss by when computing the worst-case loss of a trade (0.01 = 1%).
stop_gap_allowance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher counts more risk per open trade, leaving less available cash and smaller positions; lower counts less.

stop_model.description: Which stop model the strategy uses: 'atr_width_dial' (one parameter, volatility_tolerance, positioned on the ATR width) or 'weighted_atr' (superseded: a weighted blend of two ATRs, capped). Pinned at creation and immutable.
stop_model.x-mangrove-effect: Not a magnitude knob; selects the stop algorithm. Do not change on an existing strategy -- it would move every stop the strategy takes.

taker_fee_rate.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Venue fee per fill as a fraction of notional, charged in cash (0.004 = 0.4%).
taker_fee_rate.x-mangrove-effect: Higher counts more cost per fill, raising the risk of each trade and lowering available cash. Models the venue; not a strategy-character knob.

target_asset_weight.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Target share of core value held in the asset (0.8 = 80% asset, 20% cash; 0 = all cash).
target_asset_weight.x-mangrove-effect: Higher holds more of the asset and less cash; lower holds more cash. The daily core order moves the split back to this value once it drifts past rebalance_band. At 0 with no asset held, no core order is placed and only buy trades can pass.

target_volatility.description: Target volatility (0.10 = 10%). ONLY active when enable_volatility_adjustment is true (default false). When active, scales position size down if ATR%% of entry exceeds the target (never up).
target_volatility.x-mangrove-effect: With the gate off (the default), changing this has no effect. With it on, lower scales positions down more aggressively in high volatility.
target_volatility.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

volatility_mode.description: Unused (retained for backward compatibility). Volatility is derived from ATR.
volatility_mode.x-mangrove-effect: No runtime effect. Do not tune.

volatility_tolerance.description: Where on the ATR width the stop is taken, as the ATR_long-vs-ATR_short contribution ratio: 0 is all short end (0.5x the signal timeframe's ATR), 1 is all long end (2x the daily ATR). Interpolated geometrically, so the value is exactly the long end's share of log(stop) and each 0.1 is the same multiplicative step. Replaces atr_short_weight, atr_long_weight and atr_cap_multiplier.
volatility_tolerance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher widens the stop, and because position size is the risk budget divided by the stop distance, exposure shrinks in exact inverse proportion at the SAME risk. Low means many units with little room to be wrong and frequent stop-outs; high means few units that are hard to shake out but need a much larger move to reach the same reward. Both risk max_risk_per_trade.
volatility_tolerance.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

volatility_window.description: Unused (retained for backward compatibility). ATR windowing is controlled by atr_period.
volatility_window.x-mangrove-effect: No runtime effect. Do not tune.
volatility_window.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

circuit_breaker.description: Parameters for cooldown_model 'trades': pause on consecutive net losses or accumulated loss amount, pause on marked drawdown from the peak (including unrealized changes), resume new alpha positions at a reduced size, and stop after consecutive pauses. Canon defaults are 36 primary bars for a loss pause, 72 for a drawdown pause, and three strikes for a permanent halt. Pause counts are clamped to 24 hours through 14 days by default. max_drawdown_halt_limit separately stops entries on realized loss of cumulative gross deposits. Existing exits remain active during holds.

consecutive_loss_limit.description: Consecutive losing closes on an asset that start a pause. A winning close resets the count.
consecutive_loss_limit.x-mangrove-effect: Lower pauses sooner after a losing run; higher tolerates longer runs.

drawdown_pause_bars.description: Primary-timeframe bars denying entries after a drawdown pause (canon default 72). At drawdown-pause expiry the peak re-baselines to current account value. An alpha resume window opens only once no pause remains and no permanent halt is latched. The count is raised to cover pause_min_hours and lowered to fit pause_max_days (24 hours through 14 days by default).
drawdown_pause_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Longer holds the pause longer before trading can resume.

loss_amount_pct.description: Accumulated net losses as a fraction of the closed-equity reset baseline that start a loss pause. A winning close clears the accumulation and resets the baseline. An asset loss pause clears it at the start and re-baselines at expiry; a global drawdown pause does not itself reset it.
loss_amount_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Lower pauses after smaller cumulative losses; higher tolerates larger ones.

max_consecutive_pauses.description: Strikes that stop the strategy until a manual restart. A strike is one pause started, of any kind (consecutive losses, loss amount, drawdown, a resume window that lost money). Strikes reset to 0 only on a new equity high: a close that leaves closed equity above the high-water mark the strategy had when the first strike of the run was recorded. A winning close below that mark does not reset them, and a deposit or withdrawal does not count as a high.
max_consecutive_pauses.x-mangrove-effect: Lower stops the strategy sooner; higher tolerates more repeated pauses.

pause_bars.description: Primary-timeframe bars denying entries after a loss pause (canon default 36). The count is raised to cover pause_min_hours and lowered to fit pause_max_days on that timeframe (24 hours through 14 days by default).
pause_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Longer sits out more of a bad regime; shorter resumes sooner.

pause_max_days.description: A pause lasts at most this many days on every timeframe: the bar count is lowered to fit it.
pause_max_days.x-mangrove-effect: Lower ends every pause sooner on long timeframes; higher leaves the bar count to decide.

pause_min_hours.description: A pause lasts at least this many hours on every timeframe: the bar count of pause_bars or drawdown_pause_bars is raised to cover it.
pause_min_hours.x-mangrove-effect: Higher makes every pause at least that long on short timeframes; lower leaves the bar count to decide.

resume_size_fraction.description: Fraction of normal size for new alpha positions while a resume window is open (canon default 0.5). Eligible confirmed position closes count toward resume_trades; a negative net result starts another loss pause and strike, while zero or a profit restores full alpha size. Core orders keep their normal allocation quantities after pause expiry: they are not positions and do not consume resume-trade counts. 1.0 disables the alpha size reduction.
resume_size_fraction.x-mangrove-effect: Lower risks less while the strategy proves itself again after a pause; higher resumes closer to full size.

resume_trades.description: Eligible confirmed position closes booked in a resume window (canon default three). When the window completes, a negative net realized result starts a new loss pause and strike; zero or a profit restores full alpha size. A pause cancels the active window; a new one opens only once no pause remains and no permanent halt is latched. Core orders do not count as position closes.
resume_trades.x-mangrove-effect: Higher judges the resumed strategy over more trades before full size returns; lower decides sooner.

max_drawdown_halt_limit.description: Permanent capital-floor entry halt (0.20 = 20%). Closed, realized equity is compared with cumulative gross deposits (execution_state.cumulative_deposits), not a rolling peak or the signed net-funding balance; withdrawals do not reduce this reference. Legacy requests without cumulative_deposits use execution_config.initial_balance. The shared live/paper evaluator checks before each bar and latches execution_state.halt. New alpha entries and v3 core allocations are denied, while authoritative positions retain protective exits and exits_pending until physically flat. Engine-owned strategies become inactive only after that book is flat; caller-owned executors retain their exit monitor. An explicit manual restart is required to clear the latch. Backtests enforce the same floor when evaluate_bar receives enforce_capital_floor=True, managing open-position exits through the final bar. max_drawdown_limit.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_hold_bars.description: Maximum bars to hold any position before a forced exit.
max_hold_bars.x-mangrove-effect: Higher lets trades run longer; lower forces earlier time-based exits.
max_hold_bars.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_hold_time_hours.description: Maximum position hold time in hours (null = no limit).
max_hold_time_hours.x-mangrove-effect: Lower forces earlier time-based exits; null/higher lets trades run indefinitely on time.
max_hold_time_hours.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_open_positions.x-mangrove-effect: Higher allows more simultaneous exposure (more diversification but more aggregate risk); lower is more selective with less aggregate exposure.
max_open_positions.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_risk_per_trade.description: Fraction of account equity risked per trade (0.01 = 1%). Position size is derived from this and the stop distance.
max_risk_per_trade.x-mangrove-effect: Higher risks more per trade: bigger positions, larger gains AND larger drawdowns. Lower is more conservative: smaller positions, smaller swings.
max_risk_per_trade.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_trade_amount.description: Absolute cap on dollar size per trade.
max_trade_amount.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_trades_per_day.x-mangrove-effect: Higher permits more churn; lower throttles activity.
max_trades_per_day.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

max_units_per_trade.description: Absolute cap on units per trade.
max_units_per_trade.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_asset_balance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Minimum asset balance, in asset units, the strategy holds outside open trades.
min_asset_balance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more of the asset out of reach of sell trades and core sells, and takes more cash to reach; lower frees more of the asset for trading.

min_balance_days.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Number of equal daily orders used to bring a side up to its minimum balance.
min_balance_days.x-mangrove-effect: Higher spreads the minimum-balance orders over more days at smaller size; lower reaches the minimum sooner with larger orders.

min_balance_threshold.description: Cash reserve fraction held back from new entries (0.1 = 10%). v1 reserves this fraction of cash; v2 reserves this fraction of account value (cash + open positions at market). An entry may only use cash above the reserve; when no cash is deployable the entry is denied (insufficient_cash / insufficient_cash_v2_account_reserve). It never halts the strategy and never closes positions.
min_balance_threshold.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more cash idle and makes entries smaller or rarer as the account shrinks; lower lets entries use more of the balance. Not a drawdown stop; see max_drawdown_limit and max_drawdown_halt_limit.
min_balance_threshold.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_cash_balance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Minimum cash balance the strategy holds after the worst-case loss of every open trade.
min_cash_balance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher keeps more cash out of reach of buy trades and core buys, so entries are smaller or rarer; lower frees more cash for trading.

min_stop_distance_pct.description: Hard floor on stop distance as a fraction of entry price (crypto minimum), applied after ATR sizing.
min_stop_distance_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Higher enforces a wider minimum stop; lower allows tighter stops down to the floor.
min_stop_distance_pct.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

min_trade_amount.description: Minimum trade size in dollars; smaller intended trades are skipped.
min_trade_amount.x-mangrove-effect: Higher skips more small signals; lower allows smaller trades.
min_trade_amount.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

position_size_calc.description: Sizing-engine version ('v1', 'v2' or 'v3'). Pinned at creation and immutable. 'v3' holds an asset balance and a cash balance, sizes against equity net of open risk, and requires the position_size_calc 'v3' parameters.
position_size_calc.x-mangrove-effect: Not a magnitude knob; selects the sizing algorithm. Do not change on an existing strategy.

profit_threshold_pct.description: Profit threshold (5%% default) above which a position counts as 'winning' for the time-based exit logic.
profit_threshold_pct.x-mangrove-effect: Higher requires a larger gain before a position is treated as winning; lower treats smaller gains as wins.
profit_threshold_pct.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

rebalance_band.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Absolute deviation of the asset weight from target_asset_weight that triggers a rebalance order (0.05 = 5 points).
rebalance_band.x-mangrove-effect: Higher lets the split drift further before a rebalance order, so fewer core orders; lower holds the split closer to target with more core orders and more fees.

reward_factor.description: Risk/reward target. Take-profit distance = reward_factor * stop_distance.
reward_factor.x-mangrove-effect: Higher sets a wider profit target: lower win rate but bigger wins. Lower sets a tighter target: higher win rate but smaller wins.
reward_factor.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

stop_gap_allowance.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Fraction of the stop price a stop fill is assumed to miss by when computing the worst-case loss of a trade (0.01 = 1%).
stop_gap_allowance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher counts more risk per open trade, leaving less available cash and smaller positions; lower counts less.

stop_model.description: Which stop model the strategy uses: 'atr_width_dial' (one parameter, volatility_tolerance, positioned on the ATR width) or 'weighted_atr' (superseded: a weighted blend of two ATRs, capped). Pinned at creation and immutable.
stop_model.x-mangrove-effect: Not a magnitude knob; selects the stop algorithm. Do not change on an existing strategy -- it would move every stop the strategy takes.

taker_fee_rate.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Venue fee per fill as a fraction of notional, charged in cash (0.004 = 0.4%).
taker_fee_rate.x-mangrove-effect: Higher counts more cost per fill, raising the risk of each trade and lowering available cash. Models the venue; not a strategy-character knob.

target_asset_weight.description: position_size_calc 'v3' only. Target share of core value held in the asset (0.8 = 80% asset, 20% cash; 0 = all cash).
target_asset_weight.x-mangrove-effect: Higher holds more of the asset and less cash; lower holds more cash. The daily core order moves the split back to this value once it drifts past rebalance_band. At 0 with no asset held, no core order is placed and only buy trades can pass.

target_volatility.description: Target volatility (0.10 = 10%). ONLY active when enable_volatility_adjustment is true (default false). When active, scales position size down if ATR%% of entry exceeds the target (never up).
target_volatility.x-mangrove-effect: With the gate off (the default), changing this has no effect. With it on, lower scales positions down more aggressively in high volatility.
target_volatility.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

volatility_mode.description: Unused (retained for backward compatibility). Volatility is derived from ATR.
volatility_mode.x-mangrove-effect: No runtime effect. Do not tune.

volatility_tolerance.description: Where on the ATR width the stop is taken, as the ATR_long-vs-ATR_short contribution ratio: 0 is all short end (0.5x the signal timeframe's ATR), 1 is all long end (2x the daily ATR). Interpolated geometrically, so the value is exactly the long end's share of log(stop) and each 0.1 is the same multiplicative step. Replaces atr_short_weight, atr_long_weight and atr_cap_multiplier.
volatility_tolerance.x-mangrove-effect: Higher widens the stop, and because position size is the risk budget divided by the stop distance, exposure shrinks in exact inverse proportion at the SAME risk. Low means many units with little room to be wrong and frequent stop-outs; high means few units that are hard to shake out but need a much larger move to reach the same reward. Both risk max_risk_per_trade.
volatility_tolerance.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.

volatility_window.description: Unused (retained for backward compatibility). ATR windowing is controlled by atr_period.
volatility_window.x-mangrove-effect: No runtime effect. Do not tune.
volatility_window.x-mangrove-input-coercion: Top-level validate_execution_config accepts finite numeric strings; integer fields require whole values. Version-specific checks remain separate.
